name: 32nd International Panel Data Conference (IPDC 2027)
deadline_note: Deadline not yet set: submission page says "no later than (to be announced)". 2026 edition: submissions opened late October 2025, deadline 1 March 2026.
submission_requirements: Complete the online submission form and email a PDF of the full paper (preliminary drafts accepted). One paper per author; each presenter may present at most one paper. Registration fee waivers or travel support may be requested, subject to availability.
keynotes: Juan Carlos Escanciano (Universidad Carlos III); Ivan Fernandez-Val (Boston University); M. Hashem Pesaran (University of Cambridge); Yuya Sasaki (Vanderbilt University)
